theorems.name: add_comm
theorems.statement: ∀ a b, add a b = add b a

theorems.name: draft_never_ships
theorems.statement: ∀ trackingId, ship(draft, trackingId) refuses with "a draft order cannot ship"

theorems.name: same_currency_adds
theorems.statement: ∀ a b sharing a currency whose amounts sum within Int53, addMoney(a, b) = ok(a.amount + b.amount)

theorems.name: add_calls_agree
theorems.statement: for any arguments, the generated add returns what eval returns, entry check included

theorems.name: add_refuses
theorems.statement: for any arguments eval would not accept, the generated add throws instead of computing

theorems.name: add_traps
theorems.statement: for any arguments eval accepts, if eval throws — out of fuel and no matching arm aside — the generated add throws the same code
